title: Retention Support - Manager
description:
**Responsibilities**

* **Renewal Operations & Retention Support**
* Ensure timely and accurate generation of Renewal Notices (RN) in coordination with Underwriting, Operations, and Technology teams.
* Oversee preparation and distribution of renewal data dumps for Branches, Contact Centre and Sales teams within agreed timelines.
* Provide business support to branches and internal stakeholders for renewal-related queries, allocation issues, and operational escalations.
* Support central retention teams with timely data and analytical inputs to drive renewal performance.
* Monitor renewal process adherence and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and customer experience.
* **Process Governance**
* Monitor process TATs and ensure adherence to defined service levels across renewal operations.
* Maintain and periodically update SOPs, process documents, and business guidelines in line with business requirements and underwriting directives.
* **MIS, Analytics & Business Insights & Automation**
* Manage and publish periodic business dashboards, retention scorecards, product performance reports, conversion reports, and management MIS.
* Generate performance analysis across Zones, Regions, Branches, Products, IMDs, and Employees.
* **Incentive & Performance Support**
* Manage preparation and validation of incentive calculation files across retention channels.
* Support business teams with performance tracking and productivity reporting.
* **Data Quality, Reporting Governance & Controls**
* Conduct periodic validation of system reports and other business intelligence outputs to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
* Identify reporting gaps and collaborate with Technology and internal teams for report enhancements and new report development.
* Support business requirement documentation by providing report logic, business rules, and data definitions.
* Ensure adherence to reporting governance standards and audit requirements.
* **RN Regeneration & Exception Management**
* Monitor and track all renewal notice regeneration requests.
* Investigate root causes of regeneration requirements and drive permanent corrective measures.
* Maintain governance around renewal exceptions, process deviations, and operational controls.
* Recommend preventive controls to reduce recurring issues and improve process stability.
* **Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a key liaison between Business, Technology, Underwriting, Operations, Actuarial, Audit, and Compliance teams.
* Drive collaboration to ensure timely delivery of renewal support activities and automation initiatives

**Qualifications**

* Education: Postgraduate
* Experience: 5+ years

**Required Skills**

* Skills: Experience in Insurance Operations, Retention, Renewal Management, MIS, Business Support, Process Excellence, or Automation.
* Mindset: Ownership & Resolution Orientation, strong customer relationships, understanding customer concerns, and drive policy renewals through effective engagement.

title: Assistant Manager - SCM
description:
**Role: Strategy and MIS** 
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Manage and analyse SCM data to enable data\-driven decision\-making and management reviews.
* Prepare and share periodic MIS reports, dashboards, presentations and performance summaries.
* Track SCM KPIs, strategic initiatives, action plans and process\-improvement programmes.
* Analyse procurement, supplier, delivery, cost and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to collect, validate and consolidate business inputs.
* Support the SCM team in strategic planning, business reviews and timely closure of key action items.


**Candidate Requirements**
* Postgraduate qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance or Management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a structured, data\-driven approach.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and other data visualisation tools.
* Good understanding of supply chain processes, performance metrics, business reporting and stakeholder management.
